"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/observer-regex-values-20261010/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Select complete authored regex recipes before current native observation."""
import re
from common import AUTHORITY, BASE, CENSUS, SCALAR, SCOPE, canonical, module, need, pin, read, save


def source():
    return module(SCALAR/'derive.py')['source']()


def recipes(authority):
    catalogue = authority['source_recipes']
    test = catalogue['source_units']['test']['body']
    result = []
    for helper in catalogue['callbacks']:
        statement, declaration = helper['source_statement'], helper['source_declaration']
        need(statement in test and (declaration is None or declaration in test), 'whole authored source statement/declaration custody')
        location = declaration or statement
        expressions = list(re.finditer(r'qr/([^/\n]*)/([A-Za-z]*)', location))
        need(len(expressions) == 1, 'one complete finite authored regex expression')
        match = expressions[0]
        body, flags = match.groups()
        need(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_ .'*]+", body) is not None and flags == '',
             'finite authored ASCII pattern alphabet and absent modifiers')
        need(helper['pattern'] == '(?^:'+body+')', 'source literal versus inherited pattern evidence')
        result.append(dict(helper=helper['index'], statement=statement, declaration=declaration,
            expression=match.group(), body=body, authored_modifiers=flags, source_encoding='ASCII characters',
            original_native_flags_encoding='not measured', label=helper['label'], subtest=helper['subtest'],
            api_members=helper['api_members'], parse_members=helper['parse_members']))
    return result


def collect(authority, census, model):
    authored = recipes(authority)
    by_helper = {r['helper']:r for r in authored}
    need(len(by_helper) == len(authored), 'distinct whole authored helper allocation')
    members = []
    for row in census['operands']:
        if row['schema'] != 'regex_source':
            continue
        path = row['path']
        need(path[:1] == ['modes'] and path[2] == 'cases' and path[4] == 'phases', 'complete regex case/phase path')
        case = model['modes'][path[1]]['cases'][path[3]]
        recipe = by_helper[case['helper']]
        need(case['index'] in recipe['api_members' if case['domain']=='api' else 'parse_members']
             and case['subtest'] == recipe['subtest'], 'whole authored helper case/subtest allocation')
        operand = row['input']
        need(operand == dict(kind='regex_source', role='source_refusal_pattern', source_pattern='(?^:'+recipe['body']+')',
             display_body=recipe['body']), 'whole source regex operand body/role/schema')
        members.append(dict(path=path, helper=case['helper'], mode=model['modes'][path[1]]['mode'],
            domain=case['domain'], index=case['index'], phase=path[5], operand=operand))
    return dict(scope=SCOPE, authored=authored, members=members)


def token(body, flags, limit):
    complete = limit < 3 or len(body) <= limit
    prefix = body if complete else body[:limit-3]
    return dict(token='qr('+prefix+')'+('' if complete else '...')+flags, prefix=prefix, complete=complete)


def plan(product):
    bodies = sorted({r['body'] for r in product['authored']})
    cases = []
    for body in bodies:
        for constructor in ('literal', 'byte-string', 'upgraded-string'):
            flags = 'u' if constructor == 'upgraded-string' else ''
            for limit in (16, 64, 0):
                cases.append(dict(id=pin(canonical([body,constructor,limit]))['sha256'], body=body,
                    expression='qr/'+body+'/', constructor=constructor, modifiers=flags,
                    pattern_utf8=constructor=='upgraded-string', limit=limit, display=token(body,flags,limit)))
    return dict(scope=SCOPE, profile=dict(MaxArgNums=0, MaxEvalLen=0, RefArgFormatter=None), cases=cases)


def main():
    model = source()
    product = collect(read(AUTHORITY), read(CENSUS/'census.json'), model)
    save('regexes.json',product)
    save('plan.json',plan(product))
    need(not (BASE/'native.json').exists(), 'source hypotheses before native observation')
    save('pre-observation.json',dict(native_present=False, scope=SCOPE,
        inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in [AUTHORITY, CENSUS/'census.json', CENSUS/'source-models.json',
            *sorted(BASE.glob('*.py')), BASE/'native.pl', BASE/'regexes.json', BASE/'plan.json']}))
    print('PASS whole authored expressions, source allocations and finite public regex hypotheses before native observation.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Independent literal parsing, source traversal and whole public trace oracle."""
import json
from common import BASE, SCOPE, canonical, need, pin, same


def authored(authority):
    catalogue = authority['source_recipes']
    body = catalogue['source_units']['test']['body']
    result = []
    for helper in catalogue['callbacks']:
        statement, declaration = helper['source_statement'], helper['source_declaration']
        need(statement in body and (declaration is None or declaration in body), 'independent whole authored source custody')
        text = statement if declaration is None else declaration
        need(text.count('qr/') == 1, 'independent unique authored qr expression')
        start = text.index('qr/')
        stop = text.index('/', start+3)
        pattern = text[start+3:stop]
        end = stop+1
        while end < len(text) and text[end].isalpha():
            end += 1
        modifiers = text[stop+1:end]
        alphabet = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_ .'*-")
        need(pattern and set(pattern) <= alphabet and not modifiers,
             'independent whole ASCII pattern/absent authored modifiers')
        need(helper['pattern'] == '(?^:'+pattern+')', 'independent source versus dated pattern meaning')
        result.append(dict(helper=helper['index'], statement=statement, declaration=declaration,
            expression=text[start:end], body=pattern, authored_modifiers=modifiers, source_encoding='ASCII characters',
            original_native_flags_encoding='not measured', label=helper['label'], subtest=helper['subtest'],
            api_members=helper['api_members'], parse_members=helper['parse_members']))
    return result


def members(model, recipes):
    result = []
    pending = [(model['modes'], ['modes'])]
    helpers = {r['helper']:r for r in recipes}
    while pending:
        value, path = pending.pop()
        if type(value) is list:
            pending.extend((value[i], path+[i]) for i in reversed(range(len(value))))
        elif type(value) is dict:
            if value.get('kind') == 'regex_source':
                need(set(value) == {'kind','role','source_pattern','display_body'} and value['role']=='source_refusal_pattern',
                     'independent closed source regex schema/role')
                mode, case = model['modes'][path[1]], model['modes'][path[1]]['cases'][path[3]]
                recipe = helpers[case['helper']]
                need(case['index'] in recipe['api_members' if case['domain']=='api' else 'parse_members']
                     and case['subtest']==recipe['subtest'], 'independent entire helper/source case allocation')
                need(value['source_pattern']=='(?^:'+recipe['body']+')' and value['display_body']==recipe['body'],
                     'independent complete source regex body')
                result.append(dict(path=path,helper=case['helper'],mode=mode['mode'],domain=case['domain'],
                    index=case['index'],phase=path[5],operand=value))
            pending.extend((value[k],path+[k]) for k in sorted(value,reverse=True))
    return result


def selected(recipes):
    result = []
    patterns = set(r['body'] for r in recipes)
    for body in sorted(patterns):
        for constructor in ['literal','byte-string','upgraded-string']:
            unicode = constructor == 'upgraded-string'
            flags = 'u' if unicode else ''
            for length in [16,64,0]:
                complete = length <= 2 or len(body) <= length
                visible = body if complete else ''.join(body[i] for i in range(length-3))
                spelling = ''.join(['qr(',visible,')','' if complete else '...',flags])
                result.append(dict(id=pin(canonical([body,constructor,length]))['sha256'],body=body,
                    expression='qr/'+body+'/',constructor=constructor,modifiers=flags,pattern_utf8=unicode,limit=length,
                    display=dict(token=spelling,prefix=visible,complete=complete)))
    return result


def source(authority,model,product,plan):
    need(set(product)=={'scope','authored','members'} and set(plan)=={'scope','profile','cases'}, 'closed complete regex products')
    need(product['scope']==plan['scope']==SCOPE,'original versus current regex scope')
    recipes = authored(authority)
    need(same(recipes,product['authored']),'whole independent authored regex expressions/flags/encoding')
    allocation = members(model,recipes)
    need(same(allocation,product['members']),'complete independent regex member/order/role/schema allocation')
    need(same(plan['profile'],dict(MaxArgNums=0,MaxEvalLen=0,RefArgFormatter=None)),'selected complete public profile')
    cases = selected(recipes)
    need(same(cases,plan['cases']),'whole independent regex constructor/value/flags/encoding/display hypotheses')
    return dict(authored=pin(canonical(recipes)),members=pin(canonical(allocation)),cases=pin(canonical(cases)),scope=SCOPE)


def native(plan,receipt,driver):
    need(set(receipt)=={'command','status','stdout','stderr','inputs'},'closed complete public regex receipt')
    need(type(receipt['status']) is int and receipt['status']==0 and receipt['stderr']=='','actual typed public regex success')
    observed=json.loads(receipt['stdout'])
    need(set(observed)=={'runtime','rows'} and set(observed['runtime'])=={'perl','carp','json_pp'}
         and all(type(v) is str and v for v in observed['runtime'].values()),'complete public runtime metadata')
    need([r['id'] for r in observed['rows']]==[r['id'] for r in plan['cases']],'complete ordered public regex corpus')
    lines=driver.decode().splitlines()
    called=next(i for i,line in enumerate(lines,1) if 'my $trace = emitter();' in line)
    caller=next(i for i,line in enumerate(lines,1) if 'my $row = displayed($regex);' in line)
    for case,row in zip(plan['cases'],observed['rows'],strict=True):
        need(set(row)=={'id','trace','value','profile','source_utf8'},'closed whole native regex observation')
        need(same(row['profile'],dict(**plan['profile'],MaxArgLen=case['limit'])),'actual complete selected regex profile')
        need(type(row['source_utf8']) is bool and row['source_utf8']==case['pattern_utf8'],'current selected constructor input encoding')
        expected=dict(kind='Regexp',codepoints=[ord(c) for c in case['body']],modifiers=case['modifiers'],
            pattern_utf8=case['pattern_utf8'],normalized='(?^'+case['modifiers']+':'+case['body']+')')
        need(same(row['value'],expected),'whole public compiled pattern/flags/encoding/normalized value')
        expected_trace=('regex source fixture at '+str(BASE/'native.pl')+' line '+str(called)+'.\n'
            '\tmain::displayed('+case['display']['token']+') called at '+str(BASE/'native.pl')+' line '+str(caller)+'\n')
        need(row['trace']==expected_trace,'whole source-generated regex public header and trace')
    # Actual paired construction intervention: unchanged characters, different
    # explicit input representation and resulting public modifiers/displays.
    for index in range(0,len(observed['rows']),9):
        literal,byte,wide=(observed['rows'][index+i] for i in (2,5,8))
        need(literal['value']==byte['value'] and byte['value']['codepoints']==wide['value']['codepoints']
             and byte['value']['modifiers']!=wide['value']['modifiers'], 'actual whole byte/upgraded construction separation')
    return dict(native=pin(receipt['stdout'].encode()),scope=SCOPE)

"""Execute the full inherited reader set and committed scalar qualification."""
import subprocess
from common import AUTHORITY, BASE, CENSUS, SCALAR, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, module, need, pin, save
from run import execute


def inputs():
    return [AUTHORITY, CENSUS/'census.json', CENSUS/'source-models.json',
            SCALAR/'manifest-qualified.json', SCALAR/'qualified-proof.json']


def readers():
    result = dict(module(Path('docs/audits/observer-predicate-values-20261010/common.py'))['READERS'])
    result['predicate-values'] = ['docs/audits/observer-predicate-values-20261010/verify.py']
    result['scalar-values'] = [str(SCALAR/'verify.py')]
    return result


from pathlib import Path


def main():
    fixed = {}
    for path in inputs():
        command = ['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'show', REVISION+':'+str(path)]
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True)
        need(result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr and result.stdout == path.read_bytes(),
             'whole fixed/current regex prerequisite source')
        fixed[str(path)] = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, identity=pin(result.stdout))
    receipts = {name: execute('prerequisite-'+name, ['python3', '-B', *arguments])
                for name, arguments in readers().items()}
    save('prerequisites.json', dict(revision=REVISION, fixed=fixed,
        readers={k:pin(canonical(v)) for k,v in receipts.items()}, scope=SCOPE))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])
